event_text: An unauthorized party uses leaked credentials to access parts of Rackspace Spot, per Rackspace's customer notice
notes: 00:20 to 22:00 UTC Nov 17, 'about', per the notice as BleepingComputer quotes it. Converted to ET.

event_text: Rackspace learns of the intrusion after a customer report and confirms that customer was affected
notes: Date only in the report; midnight is a placeholder.

event_text: Rackspace announces Spot service fully restored, per BleepingComputer
notes: Date only in the report; midnight is a placeholder. The admin console had been down for several days.
05:59 PM per the article, taken as ET. The article page does not label its time zone.

event_text: A Spot team member writes on Spot's GitHub Discussions forum that an observability system was breached using a compromised credential, and that intrusive infrastructure changes are causing the extended outage
notes: 19:01:24 UTC per the forum timestamp. Converted to ET.

event_text: The Spot team member says on the forum that the team missed its goal of restoring service that afternoon and expects full restoration by 9am Pacific on Nov 21
notes: 23:15:17 UTC per the forum timestamp. Converted to ET. 9am PST Nov 21 is noon ET.
